nom: RODAN + FIELDS Pure C Serum with 10% Ascorbic Acid

avis.titre: Effective product, but too oily feeling!
avis.texte: I loved the results I noticed from using this product, however I hated the oily texture/feeling it left on my face after using it. So for that reason, I only gave it 3 stars out of 5. I'd still recommend it if you don't mind that oily feeling on your face from using it!
Worked great on my skin. Left my skin feeling smooth and looking bright. A must in my skincare routinr

I've tried a lot of vitamin C serums over the years, and Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum is definitely one of my favorites. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or greasy. I was a little worried it might irritate my sensitive skin, but I haven't had any issues. After using it consistently, I noticed my complexion looked brighter and more even. My skin has a healthier glow, and some of my darker spots have started to fade. It layers well under my moisturizer and sunscreen, and a little goes a long way, so the bottle lasts longer than I expected. If you're looking for a vitamin C serum that feels gentle while still delivering noticeable results, I think this one is worth trying. I'll definitely keep it in my skincare routine.

I used this serum in conjunction with my nightly routine and I noticed a difference after about 2 weeks of use as did my aesthetician when I visited her. While the serum feels oily it soaks in quickly and doesn't leave the skin with an oily feel and it doesn't end up on my pillowcases which is great.

This serum worked so effectively in plumping the skin and filling and fine wrinkles and lines. Easy to apply and absorbs quickly. It is a great and effective way to use a vitamin C serum and oil form. That is what I liked most about this serum was the fact that it absorbed really quickly. Not only is it effective at fine line and wrinkle treatment. It is great for preventative skin care.

avis.titre: Brightening Results, But Slightly Greasy Finish
avis.texte: I used the Rodan and Fields Pure C Serum for a few weeks and overall it's definitely a great product. It helped brighten my skin and improved my overall texture, making it feel smoother and more even. I also really liked that it doesn't have a strong overpowering smell like many other vitamin C serums do. The only downside for me was that it didn't fully feel like my skin absorbed it. It left a slightly greasy layer, which I wasn't the biggest fan of and ultimately why I stopped using it. Overall, I would still give it 4 stars because it does what it promises in terms of brightening and texture, I just wish the absorption felt a bit better.

avis.titre: It's gobbling up my sun spots.
avis.texte: I'm honestly surprised at how well this works. I've been using it day & night, after toner & a ceramide serum but before everything else. I'll put a few drops (you literally only need a a few) in my palm & then kind of tap & press it in with my fingertips. It's fading my sun spots & brightens, my sister asked if I'd had a peel at Easter. I love that it's super concentrated, no oil or water, that plus the makes the price worth it, imo.
I liked this product because it left my skin feeling hydrated and improved surface texture. My only dislike was that it felt oily when I first put it on.

I typically use vitamin C in the morning and a retinoid at night and continued to do so with this product. This is my third brand of vitamin C serum and so far it's held up really well. It's thicker than the other brands that I've tried and smoother. I haven't broken out from it like I have from a different brand that combines vitamin c with another vitamin and acid product. It also hasn't spoiled despite being lost in the mail for a bit and vitamin C is known to spoil so I'm very pleased. I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review.

Overall, I am quite pleased with this serum. The product goes in smoothly without leaving a sticky residue. I only use 2-3 drops and feel that is a sufficient amount. I haven't noticed my dark spots lightening quite yet, but I do feel that my skin looks more radiant. The only con to this product is that it's a bit pricey.

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: Overall I enjoyed using the Pure C Serum. In all honesty, I was a little skeptical with the consistency at first as I wasn't sure it would absorb well into my dry skin. I did not experience any issues and could notice a difference in the brightness in my skin after a few uses. I would recommend this product to a friend and will purchase myself in the future. I received this product in exchange for my review.

avis.titre: I had noticed a difference in just 4 weeks
avis.texte: I like this product as it's pure vitamin C which helps to build collagen. I noticed differences in my skin, its plumper and more even! Once I applied it I noticed a warming sensation and a slightly reddish color on my skin but it goes away almost instantly. I will recommend it and keep buying it!
I really wanted to love this but, I just don't. It's very drying and the smell is nearly unbearable.

I wanted to make sure this Rodan + Fields Vitamin C works before I leave my very honest review and I have nothing bad to say about this product. The texture is amazing and light. It is oil based but not greasy. This is how I used it: wash your face in the A. M with your favorite cleanser and then I would apply this oil only and if I go outside I make sure to use sunscreen. PLEASE use sunscreen when you use vitamin C to prevent sunburns and discoloration etc.. To be honest, I love it so much that I also use it at night with my favorite night routine. I just love it. I really do see a huge difference. I know the price is a bit high but it will last you forever and it is really worth every single penny. I highly recommend this brand.

I am always a bit skeptical when it comes to trying new products because many claim to reverse aging or wrinkles, etc... However, after using this product a few weeks, I noticed my complexion looked healthier overall. The liquid is a good consistency, fragrance is fine and it leaves my face feeling smoother. I plan to continue using it. I would highly recommend!

After using this serum for only a few weeks, i've noticed my skin is brighter, softer, and smoother. I like to apply the serum both in the mornings and at night and have definitely noticed a difference since using.

I've been trying this product for over two months now and I have to say that I am really pleased with this product. I have very sensitive skin so trying new products can be a little hesitant because many times I break out with them, but I was so pleased that I didn't with this product. I love that I wake up the next day with clear, shiny smooth skin. I highly recommend this product to anyone and I will keep using it from now on.

I've been using the Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum daily for a few weeks and I can already see a noticeable difference in my complexion! My skin is smoother, and my fine lines seem less noticeable. I also enjoy that my skin seems to have a healthy looking glow! This serum was easy to incorporate into my skincare routine. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly which makes it easy to layer with the rest of my products.I used it morning and night after cleansing, followed with moisturizer, and made sure to wear SPF during the day. Overall, this has been a really nice addition to my skincare and I plan to continue using it!

I've really been enjoying the Pure C Serum. It feels lightweight on my skin, it does take a little bit to absorb. It layers nicely under moisturizer and makeup however. After using it consistently, my complexion started to look a little brighter and more refreshed. It helps with getting that healthy glow that makes us feel put together even on no-makeup days. Overall, it's a great vitamin C serum that makes my skin look healthy and energized.
A little goes a long way, it doesn't sting like other vitamin c serums, texture of my skin feels smoother after using it 1-2 weeks, it's not dry or chalky!

avis.titre: The only vitamin C serum you'll ever need
avis.texte: I've consistently used Vitamin C in my skincare routine for years and have tried several brands, the new Pure C serum from Rodan + Fields is easily the best I've come across. I've been using it daily for 8 weeks and have noticed my skin is significantly brighter & smoother. I haven't noticed a reduction in fine lines or wrinkles but it's the middle of Winter, I'm 40 and have a 3 year old daughter and a 6 week old newborn, so I feel that would be asking a lot! What I have noticed is my skin feels firmer, more evenly toned, the texture has really improved and overall feels more youthful. I often have dry, dull skin (especially in Winter) and have tried so many different hydrating moisturizers and serums. I wouldn't have thought a vitamin C serum would've been the solution but this serum made a radical difference. I love how it feels on the skin, other serums I've tried have felt sticky, tacky, thick or even grainy, and I've often experienced a stinging sensation and/or had to wait a long time to layer products on top. The Pure C serum is so light, not at all greasy and is absorbed quickly so I'm able to moisturize and apply make-up quickly. I don't have time to hang around in the mornings so being able to complete my skin and make-up routine without having to wait too long to layer products is really valuable to me as a busy mom. It is definitely more expensive than some other brands on the market and I was skeptical whether it would be worth it for 'just' a vitamin C serum, es

avis.titre: Lightweight but need time to see the result
avis.texte: The product is really lightweight comparing to my other vitamin C products. It's a little bit oily so need to keep massaging through it for a while to let it absorbs to skin. It leaves my skin soft and smooth. I will keep using it for longer time to see if it helps to make my skin brighter and blur dark spots or not. Like it in general.
Great product. Have noticed a huge difference in my skin, fine lines and wrinkles. My skin feels softer and brighter. No oily residue.

I'm always hesitant to try vitamin C serums as a sensitive skin/eczema girl but, this serum has given me such a glow and it's gentle enough that it hasn't triggered my eczema. My skin definitely looks more supple after use and more hydrated as well!

I think I definitely need more time with this product but over the course of use, I definitely noticed my skin was smoother and plumper. The product is super easy to use, so compliance is super simple, I'm super excited to see how it continues to work but it's definitely doing its job. Make sure you use SPF with this product!

This was really great compared to other vitamins c products out there. I like the consistency and how it feels on the skin. My last vitamin c product left a sticky feel on my face so it was great to switch. I will say I have sensitive skin and so this caused some irritation. My advice is start slow, I am still only using this 2-3 times a week.

For me, this product had a learning curve since I saw instructions that read "generously apply" but then saw more instructions that mentioned "a little goes a long way". I might have started out putting too much on. I was expecting a more watery texture, but it's almost warming and thick. Do give it 30 seconds or more to absorb into your skin before adding moisturizer. I did not see major results in the time that I used it but I know R+F to be a great brand and feel I probably need more time. There was no fragrance which is also a plus!

I've been using this serum morning and night after cleansing, and I really like the lightweight and luxurious texture. Just a few drops go a long way, and it absorbs quickly, leaving my skin looking brighter right away. With continued use, my skin feels smoother and looks more even and healthy.

First impression, the design is sleek and the dropper fits tightly and securely in the bottle, which doesn't allow for leakage. Definitely a plus. After trying this serum out, it didn't dry out my skin which always is a concern with a new product. It gave a slight boost in brightness, but it left a sticky, greasy residue on my hands and my face. No real improvement to skin tone or hyperpigmentation. For me though, the texture was the biggest drawback. I'm slightly sensitive to tackiness of lotions/creams/serums and this tickled my senses in a negative way. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Quick to Brighten and Smooth Skin
avis.texte: I have been using Rodan + Field's Pure C Serum twice daily for the past 30 days and in just one month's time my skin is noticeably brighter and smoother. First of all, I love that the serum comes packaged with a dropper applicator so I can control the amount of serum being dispensed so I'm not wasting any product. I also appreciate that this serum is fragrance free since so many vitamin C serums naturally have an off-putting smell. Unfortunately, the consistency of the serum is not my favorite and it has a very oil texture, but thankfully it quickly absorbs into your skin and it does not leave your skin feeling greasy or sticky. On the contrary, once the oily feeling disappears within a minute or less of the serum being applied, my skin is left feeling velvety soft. I've used multiple different moisturizers after applying the serum and then put my makeup on after, and I haven't had any issues with piling. I've also noticed that along with the serum brightening my skin, it has also given my skin a glow that makes my face look more youthful and vibrant. I haven't used the serum long enough to see any improvements with my lines and wrinkles, but with how quickly the serum helped brighten and smooth my skin's texture I'm hopeful I'll see a difference in my lines and wrinkles within another 6-8 weeks of continued use. I highly recommend the product to others who are looking for an anti-aging serum that helps with multiple concerns.

I absolutely love this serum. It makes my face look full and youthful very moisturizing. It gives my skin, the vitamin C and other nutrition that it needs. I would definitely recommend this product to anyone.

Rodan + Fields kindly gave me this Pure C Serum for free through the BzzAgent sampling program so that I could review it. This is a moisture must for dry winter skin . I also saw some noticeable improvement in my sun spots. I worried about how my makeup would work with this and it worked beautifully under my makeup and moisturizer I just make sure i let it absorb in my skin for 2-3 min before i apply moisturizer . It also worked well with my skin. as i get older my skin seems to be more sensitive and this paired with my skin welll

I was excited to try this Vitamin C serum as I really like the brand and vitamin c serums in general. This serum is just too 'sticky' and 'tacky' for my liking. It does not smooth over my face nicely and takes too long to absorb.

Received product free to review over the course of a month. Nice application. Went on smoothly not oily. Noticed a brightness to my normal dull skin without makeup. Would use every other day in accordance with my other daily moisturizers. I would recommend for someone aged 45-55 . I like to enhance the product with a makeup brightener and glow spf I addition to my makeup to give a more refreshed look.

I used this for about two weeks and I definitely noticed that I started to get life back into my dull skin! It's not super tacky and dries down easy. Would highly recommend to anyone looking to include vitamin c to their skincare routine

avis.titre: You can see results with regular use!
avis.texte: I received this product free to use and give a honest review. I used the R&F Pure C Serum day and night for several weeks and there is a difference in appearance. Fine lines are reduced and there is a healthy glow to my skin. My complexion just looks and feels brighter. When using at night, use very sparingly as it felt too oily for my silk pillow at first. However a little goes a long way. The bottle will definitely last a long time.

I'm usually a little nervous about Vitamin C serums because my skin is reactive and can be sensitive, but the Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum has really delivered! It contains 10% ascorbic acid and has been gentle enough for me to use daily without any redness. I apply it every morning, let it fully absorb, then follow with moisturizer and SPF (never forget the SPF!) The texture is slightly thick but absorbs completely under makeup. There is also no weird smell either and if you've tried multiple Vitamin C serums, you know exactly what I'm talking about. I like that this serum focuses on collagen support. I'm at the age where that really starts to matter, and Vitamin C is one of those ingredients I can genuinely tell when I'm not using consistently. This one has officially replaced what I was using before. This isn't my first Rodan + Fields product, and I'm always impressed.

I've been using a vitamin C serum with 10% Ascorbic Acid, and I'm really happy with it. The serum absorbs quickly, feels light on the skin, and isn't sticky at all—super comfortable to apply. After a few weeks, I noticed my skin looks brighter and more even, and the dull areas have improved noticeably. My skin also feels softer and naturally firmer. For me, this is an essential step in my skincare routine, especially for anyone wanting to brighten their complexion and keep their skin healthy.

avis.titre: Glow and brightness without the sting!
avis.texte: I'm 43 with dry, sensitive skin, and I'm always nervous about Vitamin C being too harsh. This serum is a total exception. I use it every morning after cleansing, and the silky texture feels amazing--- no stinging or redness at all. It absorbs fast and layers perfectly under my thick moisturizer and SPF. After a month of use, my dark spots are fading and that "dull" look is gone. It's definitely improved my skin's overall radiance without causing any irritation. A little goes a long way!

Perfect — here's a 5-star version that still sounds natural: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been really impressed with the Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum. The texture is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't feel sticky or greasy at all. It layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen, and my skin has looked noticeably brighter and more even after using it consistently. I also love how smooth and hydrated my skin feels in the mornings. Overall, it feels like a high-quality vitamin C serum and I'd definitely recommend it, especially if you want a healthy glow.
Since adding this to my daily facial routine I've noticeable evening and brightening of my skintone.

Been using Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum for a bit now and I'm honestly impressed 🍊✨ The texture is lightweight and silky, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky feeling. My skin looks brighter, smoother, and more even, with that healthy glow that just makes you feel confident. It layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup, and a little really does go a long way. Perfect if you're looking to boost radiance and give your skin that fresh look.

avis.titre: A Must Buy and Try Serum
avis.texte: I was able to try Rodan Fields Pure C serum free in exchange for my honest opinion. I really like how well it came packaged and the overall design of the serum bottle. Looks very new and modern. I have been using this in place of my Obagi vitamin C serum for close to 3 weeks and I have noticed my fine lines are fading faintly also I have a very nice glow and general plumpness back to face and cheeks. I also have a condition called melasma where I sufferer from unusual dark spots on areas of my face and this serum seems to have lighted some of my dark spots which I am very happy and grateful for. If your skeptical on trying I deff think pure c serum is worth a shot in fact I recommend the purchase and use of this product. I will continue to use and repurchase as needed. Thank you ❤️

avis.titre: Incredible Vitamin C Serum without irritation
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum! It only takes a few drops to cover my face and neck. The consistency is in that perfect range of not too thick and not too runny. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any irritation on my somewhat sensitive skin. After using it routinely, I noticed a bright, glowy appearance to my skin. It feels softer and more hydrated.

avis.titre: Great Vitamin C - Prefer to use at night!
avis.texte: I've been enjoying the Rodan+Fields Pure C Serum for its brightening and smoothing benefits. The formula feels nourishing and leaves my skin looking more radiant and refreshed. It is on the oilier side and takes some time to fully absorb, so I personally prefer using it at night rather than during the day. Overall, it's a solid vitamin C serum that leaves my skin feeling healthy and well cared for. Looking forward to seeing the long-term benefits with continued use as I've only been using it for a couple weeks now. *I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review*

This Vitamin C Serum has been an easy addition to my morning routine. No irritation, no stinging, just a healthy glow. The application blends smoothly and absorbs fairly quick, and works well with my existing skin care routine and didn't interfere with my spf. A great vitamin c serum, I love the glow and non sticky formula.

I really enjoyed this vitamin c serum. The formulation is a clear gel with a slightly runny consistency. It smooths over the skin nicely, very easy glide. Dries down quickly and doesn't stay sticky. No significant odor, as commonly found in some Vit C serums. After two weeks of use, I felt that my skin looked refined, very smooth and has a lovely glow. Worked well with my other skincare and under makeup--no pilling or any other issue.

I've been using the Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum twice a day (just a couple drops each time), and I'm seriously impressed. My skin looks noticeably plumper, firmer, and brighter in such a short time. It absorbs quickly, feels lightweight, and layers perfectly under moisturizer and makeup. A little truly goes a long way, this one's definitely staying in my routine!
This is the best C serum that I have tried over the last 3 years. I have tried a new one each year but this may be my last. I see results and I have been using it for only 3 weeks!

I love the hydrating, almost oily texture of this vitamin c serum. It's hydrating, wears well under makeup and doesn't cause a reaction on my skin (which has reacted to vitamin c before). I've been using it for a couple of weeks and don't see a noticeable difference yet, but happily will finish off the bottle.

This vitamin C serum has been a great addition to my routine. The texture is light and non-sticky, and it sinks into my skin almost immediately. It also has a really nice, subtle scent. My skin feels smooth after application, and it works well both morning and night.

A high quality vitamin c serum that brightens the skin without irritating it. I've been using it for a month and have noticed significant improvement in my skin texture as well as brightness and even tone.

I've used the Pure C Serum for a couple weeks now and I see a huge difference in my skin. No longer dull and saggy, I'm now bouncy and glowing. My skin feels better and the serum has been good on my sensitive skin. Serum absorbs quickly, a couple drops morning and night on a clean face feels amazing!

I've only been using Rodan & Fields Pure C Serum for about a week, and so far my impression is… cautiously optimistic. I've used SkinCeuticals CE Ferulic for years, so I have a solid benchmark for vitamin C serums. The texture is lighter and more watery than SkinCeuticals, and it absorbs quickly without stickiness. It layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen, and I haven't experienced irritation, stinging, or breakouts; a win for a vitamin C product. That said, after one week I haven't noticed significant brightening or visible improvement in tone or glow. My skin feels fine and looks healthy, but there's nothing dramatic yet. I'll continue using it to see how it performs over time, but based on one week alone, this seems more like a mild, maintenance-level vitamin C rather than a heavy-hitting treatment.

I've been using Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum and I'm honestly impressed. The formula is lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky or greasy. After a few weeks of consistent use, my skin looks brighter, smoother, and more even overall. It layers well with my other skincare and under makeup, and I haven't experienced irritation or breakouts. While it is on the pricier side, a little goes a long way and the results make it worth it. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.

I love this Vitamin C serum! Though I haven't been using it for too long, I can tell that my skin is responding to this well and it's already looking brighter! I have a few sun spots from the summer, and I've noticed them get slightly lighter ever since I started using this serum (use it every morning before SPF). Can't wait to continue using it and see what more results I can get!

I've been using the Rodan + Fields Active C Serum and it is definitely a powerful, active product that you need to ease into — especially if you have sensitive skin like I do. The instructions recommend using it twice a day, but I started with once a day for the first week to let my skin adjust. After that, I worked up to using it morning and night with no issues. That gradual approach made a big difference for me. What I've noticed most is how much my forehead lines have softened. My skin also looks more radiant overall, and the change in my neck lines has been especially impressive. I used to notice that if I was even slightly dehydrated, my neck lines would really show. Since starting this serum, they're far less noticeable — to the point where I don't really see them anymore, which has been wonderful. This is not a "gentle" vitamin C — it's effective and you can feel that — but if you introduce it slowly, the results are absolutely worth it.

avis.titre: Potent strength but making a difference!
avis.texte: First things first, it does NOT smell like hot water. Lol. You need less than a dropper full and it's thick in texture. It's easy to massage in and feels good. It works fine under makeup if you give a few minutes to let it sink in. I started off using it daily and have updated to every other day as it was too much for daily use, even though my skin is not sensitive. I've only used it for a few weeks but can see brighter, less dull skin. I do recommend it if you don't have too sensitive skin and I may purchase once I am out, but I know this will last a long time because you need so little.

avis.titre: New staple in my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I was sent the Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum to review for a few weeks now and I'm really impressed. My skin looks brighter, more even, and just healthier overall. It absorbs quickly without feeling sticky, and I've noticed my dark spots fading and my skin tone improving. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine now. I will definitely be purchasing another once I run out.

I love the texture, Im loving the thicker formula. I've been getting these noticeable lines on my forehead and the handful of times ive used this serum, i feel the lines seem more blurred. I'm sure the area is very dry, and the serum helps hydrate so much. I love the absence of strong smells.

I used this product for two weeks to give thorough feedback, after receiving it in exchange for my honest review. I made sure to use just my cleanser, this serum, and my usual moisturizer/sunscreen. I've tried other vitamin C serums and this one is definitely my favorite. It's not oily at all; instead, it's a smooth texture that quickly absorbs into your skin. At certain times of the month, my skin is more sensitive; during this time, I felt a very slight tingle after application—any other time, I felt nothing at all. Immediately, my skin looked brighter, and after two weeks, my skin's texture was smoother, a little more plump, and my dark marks didn't have such a distinct contrast. I'm definitely going to continue using this past the trial because this serum works. For reference, I am tan-to-deep in complexion.

I have very sensitive skin. Vitamin c is very hit or miss for me. Some will work well with my skin and some will break me out. This vitamin c is amazing no quality and worth the price tag. My skin looks amazing!

I really tried to like this product. It initially dried my skin out so I cut back to every other day. It made my skin very dry and sensitive despite cutting back on the frequency. It is also a very thick serum. I was given this product in exchange for an honest review but unfortunately it was not for me.

Thanks Rodan+Fields for the free Pure C Serum. I was unsure if I would like this product because it has an oil consistency, unlike my usual creamy serum. However, it absorbs well and works flawlessly under makeup. I love how it feels on my skin! After a week, my skin was smoother, more hydrated, and even more radiant. I've received many compliments! This serum is a must!

Skincare products with Vitamin C is essential in my skincare routine, as I am in my mid thirties. This Vitamin C serum has helped to keep my skin look firmer and brighter. The serum formulated with Vitamin C complex to deliver maximum results, gentle enough for everyday use even on my sensitive skin.

This is the best Vitamin C serum I've used as far as the texture of the serum is concerned. It is lightweight and non greasy, and it absorbs quickly into the skin without pilling. I like that it only takes a few drops to cover my entire face and neck area. Since I've only been using it for close to one month, I cannot see a big difference in appearance of dark spots just yet, but my skin does have a nice glow to it since using. This serum is unscented and does not cause my skin to break out. I look forward to continued use.

I love the Rodan & Fields Serum C formula , it's a fast-absorbing, silky, and non-sticky texture serum, that layers well under moisturizers and makeup as I've aged I've noticed more fine lines and wrinkles around my eyes and smile lines and this Rodan and Fields Serum C has shown me it greatly reduced my fine lines and wrinkles. My skin has that moisturized healthy glow now. And I've just used it 3 weeks but I see great improvement . Highly recommend .

I've tried Vitamin C serums and this one is definitely different. This serum has 10% ascorbic acid, which is more than the products that I've used in the past. Because of the higher percentage, I was actually able to tell a different in the evening of my skin tone, which has always been a struggle for me. My face is brighter. The formula is not super thick. I use both day and night after cleansing and before moisturizing. I will definitely purchase when this runs out!

It's a pretty good serum. It didn't irritate my skin, which is very hit or miss with my skin and vitamin C products. It doesn't smell bad like many vitamin C serums do. It sinks in easily. My skin looked brighter. Those are the positives. However it didn't moisturize my skin at all. In fact, it dried my skin out a bit. Beyond the brightening, I didn't notice any of the other anti aging benefits promised. It might be better suited to those with oily skin, given the drying nature. I liked it okay but I wouldn't repurchase.

Rodan + Fields pure C serum works instantly and it works hard! Since it has pure vitamin C (which I always hear is a huge skin powerhouse) I was worried it might have a strong odor. It has no scent whatsoever to my great delight! It also absorbs quickly and is not sticky. You also only need a little bit so it will last a long time. I am ready to make this my new serum for anti aging and barrier protection.

avis.titre: One of those things you didn't know you needed!
avis.texte: When I first went to apply this, I was like what in the world. It feels like a silicone base lubricant. But I stuck with it. I then applied my base over it and the rest of my makeup. That's when the WOW factor happened for me. I've tried doing my makeup over other moisturizers and serums and I have not ever had one work this well. This is like a serum and primer in one. My base spreads magically! LOVE LOVE LOVE IT!

I have used the product every morning and night as directed, and thankfully, it has not caused any irritation or breakouts to my skin. As a woman of a particular age, I wish the percentage of Vitamin C was higher, but it's not terrible. I also really enjoy the consistency of the serum, it isn't too oily or grainy and plays well with other products as makeup. In terms of effectiveness, I will need more time with the product to determine that but so far, so good.

As someone who has used multiple Vitamin C products this one might just be my favorite! It goes on SO nicely and leaves your skin feeling very hydrated. I do get the slight tingle from it which is normal with vitamin c products. I also love that it doesn't have that strong vitamin C smell, if you know, you know!

This product instantly makes my skin feel hydrated and appear glowing. The texture is somewhere between a serum and an oil, however absorbs beautifully and never leaves my skin feeling greasy. Usually my skin is dull during the winter months but using this C serum has really brightened me up! So glad to have this as part of my winter routine. While I did receive this product in exchange for my honest opinion, I'm extremely picky with fragrance and texture. There is no strong smell at all and leaves nothing but soft, radiant skin.

I wanted to continue testing this out before I wrote a review. So far, I am liking the product and have seen slight improvement with my skin tone. Mainly redness around my nose and cheeks. I received this for free from bzzagent in exchange for my review.

avis.titre: A warm way to hydrate and brighten the skin
avis.texte: The Rodan & Fields Pure C Serum is a perfect addition to the AM and PM routine. The serum feels warm as you rub it in on the skin. The absorption is instant. Perfect for under concealer, foundation or primer. Living in the desert this product is even more effective for those dry days. Highly recommend.

Rodan + Fields gifted me this product for free in exchange for my honest review. Like the title says, Wow! This Vitamin C is unlike any I've tried to date — and I've tried so, so many. The first thing I noticed about this serum is the lack of smell. Sometimes Vitamin C can have a rather unpleasant smell, but this serum does not. It has zero smell or fragrance in it. After using this serum for a little over a month I feel like my skin looks plumper, and radiant — the puffiness I would sometimes see in the morning has diminished and my skin is clearer with less noticeable dark spots from sun and old breakouts. My favorite thing about this serum, though, is the texture. It's silky smooth and leaves behind the most subtle glow. My skin glows all day without looking oily. I hands down recommend this vitamin c serum — it's holy grail status!

*I recieved this product in exchange for a review* pretty concentrated Vitamin C product. It did make me a little red at first, but it didn't hurt! Paired with my moisturizer, it made my skin very glowy. It also kept my skin hydrated all day. I can't yet speak to long term results, but I'd definitely continue using the product.
I got this as a sample and was skeptical at first. I took a before and after picture. There is a huge difference!

avis.titre: Smells Nice But Feels Like a Chemical Burn
avis.texte: I wanted to love Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum, but unfortunately my experience was extremely negative. Even when using a very small amount and slowly trying to build up over the course of a week, this product burned my skin. After application, my face became red and felt intensely sunburned. Over the following days, my skin grew dry, irritated, and eventually started peeling. I followed the directions carefully and took a cautious approach, yet the reaction only worsened instead of improving. The only positive thing I can say is that the scent is pleasant—but that alone doesn't make up for the discomfort and damage I experienced. Skincare should support your skin barrier, not compromise it. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this product, especially for anyone with sensitive or reactive skin.

I have tried my fair share of vitamin c serums so I know that not all are created equally - this one is AMAZING. The ingredients are pure and effective. This has completely transformed my skin in the few weeks that I've been using it. The fine lines by my eyes have faded, my skin looks so much glowier, and I feel more confident since using this. This is a quality serum worth adding to your skincare routine - my search for the perfect vitamin c serum has finally ended with the winner!

I use Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum as part of my daily skincare routine, usually applying it to clean, dry skin before moisturizer. I like that it feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving my skin greasy, and I've noticed my skin looks brighter and more even over time. I also appreciate that it layers well under makeup.

I'm a little confused by this product. It states it is oil free, yet it feels very oily upon application. It does sink in well and makes my face feel smooth and soft. I haven't seen big results such as waking up feeling my skin is brighter from this product as I have other Vitamin C products. (Being an esthetician I have used a lot of them,) this could be a "long game" product, that takes a while to see results, but because I haven't had a lot of time since receiving it to see, I can't speak to the brightening claims. I also do not have pigmentation issues. I do also do rotate this with retinol, so that could also feed into the issue of not using as regularly to see better results. My skin leans sensitive and though I would recommend for some clients to use vitamin C in the AM and retinol in the PM, especially during the cold winter months in Wisconsin with my skin barrier frequently becoming compromised, this just isn't an option for me. My final thoughts are I really like the consistency (though a little confusing) I do like the way it makes my skin feel, I have noticed softening in the couple of weeks that I have been using it, and slight brightening. I do look forward to continuing to use this product especially in the summer months. And wish I had longer time with it before my review was due. I received this product for free for testing and review purposes

I use the serum morning and night after cleansing and before moisturizer. It absorbs well into my skin. My skin looks brighter after use. I'd recommend getting it if you're looking for a quality serum for your skincare routine. I'm 41 years old, fair skin with sun discoloration.

I received this product for free in exchange for an honest opinion. I love everything about it. It goes on clear, a little goes a long way. It has no scent, absorbs immediately, and is easy to apply with the dropper. I could feel it work. It had a slight warming sensation when it touched my skin. The product has 10% asorbic acid to support collagen production to reduce wrinkles, lines, and facial discoloration. Ginger-derived antioxidants fight free radicals. I noticed fine line reductions without any skin irritation. I applied it morning and evening after cleansing my face. My skin is softer and smoother. It looks radiant. I always apply SPF in the AM, which is recommended when using this product. Rodan+Fields is 100% cruelty free. I looked this up on the internet, as it was not mentioned on their packaging. I wished they would reference this.

I've been using this for a few weeks now and I have to say it delivers on its promise of plumping the skin and softening fine lines. After about a week of consistent use, my complexion looked noticeably smoother and more hydrated, and the fine lines around my eyes appeared far less visible. My skin also felt bouncier, almost as if it had regained some of its natural volume. The texture of the serum is silky and sinks in fairly quickly, but it does leave behind a slightly tacky finish. While that isn't a dealbreaker for me, it did make applying my powder bronzer a bit difficult it didn't blend as evenly as usual. For someone who doesn't wear a daily foundation this was a bit of an inconvenience. Overall, this serum is impressive in terms of its visible results. My skin looks healthier, smoother, and more youthful. If the slight stickiness could be refined, it would easily be a five-star product. As it stands, I'd give it 4 out of 5 stars.

I received a sample of Rowan & Fields Pure C Serum to try and review, and I was pleased with the results. The serum is thick, which was great for my dry skin, and yet it was easy to apply and two drops was enough. Immediately, I noticed my skin looked more moisturized and plumper. With continued use my skin became brighter, plumper, and smoother. My skin's texture was refreshed and there was a noticeable decrease in fine lines. The serum also didn't irritate my dry, sensitive skin. My only concern is if it will be too thick for use in the humid summer months, but so far it has been a great addition to my skincare routine.

This serum feels silky and smooth, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave any sticky residue. It gives my skin an instant glow, and over time has made it brighter and more even. I've noticed a real improvement in dullness, and my skin just looks healthier overall. It feels effective without being harsh, and just a few drops goes a long way. It also layers really nicely under moisturizer and SPF without any sort of pilling.

avis.titre: So different and makes skin look sooo good!
avis.texte: Okay. I was a little surprised at the beginning, I wasn't sure of this was actually a serum, I had to double check the label because this serum has some sort of an oily texture. I wasn't too happy about it for about a minute because I don't like oily products since I have combination skin. However, after about a minute, when the serum dried out, my skin was smooth!! No oiliness! Awesome! After about two weeks of using it, my skin was noticeably softer and felt healthier. I haven't noticed a reduction on my dark spots or large pores, or fine lines.. but I know it takes time. I'm hoping that with continued use, I'll notice some other improvements. But so far, I definitely recommend this if it's in your budget!

I have used to pure c serum continuously for 4 weeks and the results were amazing. Firstly there are no signs of rash or itching. Next, my dark spots started to fade away and my skin looks visibly brighter. It looked soft and supple. Definitely one of the best vit c serums out there. Make sure to follow up with sunscreen.
So far I've really enjoyed using this serum. It is lightweight but feels very nice on the skin. I have seen an improvement in the evenness of my skin and it looks brighter as well.

(This product was given to me for my honest review) I've been using the Rodan + Fields Pure C Brightening Serum for a few weeks now, and I'm honestly impressed. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or sticky, which is huge for me. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup and doesn't pill at all. What I noticed first was how much brighter my skin looked. My complexion started looking more even, and some dullness I didn't even realize I had just… disappeared. Over time, I also saw improvement in the look of fine lines and overall skin tone. My skin feels smoother and more refreshed every morning. I appreciate that it doesn't irritate my skin — no redness or breakouts — even though vitamin C products can sometimes be harsh. The capsules keep the serum fresh, which makes it feel like you're getting the full benefit every time you use it. It's definitely a higher-end product, but a little goes a long way, and the results make it worth it for me. If you're looking for a vitamin C serum that actually delivers brightness and glow, this one is a solid choice.

I've been using the Rodan + Fields Vitamin C Serum, and I'm honestly impressed. After just a short time, my skin looked noticeably more dewy, brighter, and far less dull. I have sensitive skin, so I was cautious and mixed it with my moisturizer and I'm glad I did. Not only did it not irritate my skin at all, but it actually made my moisturizer feel more luscious, thicker, and smoother, while still spreading easily across my face. I love that I could get visible results without any redness or discomfort. I'll definitely be purchasing this in the future.

I really like the Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum. I like the texture; it has a nice slip to it and feels light. My skin feels hydrated and smooth after using the serum. I notice my skin looks glowy and hydrated after using this serum. I really like how lightweight it feels but still hydrating.

avis.titre: I would love to stock up on this!
avis.texte: I'm so impressed by this pure C serum. It gives my skin such a smooth appearance and absorbed super fast. This bottle will last me quite awhile so it's a good bang for your buck. Can never have enough vitamin C for my skin!

avis.titre: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Holy-Grail Vitamin C for Everyday Glow
avis.texte: I've tried quite a few vitamin C serums over the years, and this one truly stands out. The texture is lightweight, silky, and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy, which makes it perfect for both morning and night routines. It layers beautifully under moisturizer and makeup and never pills. After a few weeks of consistent use, my skin looks noticeably brighter and more even. I've seen a visible improvement in dullness, and my complexion just looks healthier and more radiant overall. It also gives my skin a smoother feel, almost like it helps everything apply better on top. What I really appreciate is that it feels effective without being harsh. My skin can be sensitive, and I didn't experience irritation or redness — just a soft glow and a refreshed look. A little goes a long way, so one bottle lasts longer than expected. Yes, it's a splurge, but the quality, results, and overall experience make it worth it for me. If you're looking for a vitamin C serum that delivers real brightness and fits seamlessly into your routine, this one is a great choice. ✨ Would definitely repurchase.

It's a good quality, gentle brightening serum. It gives me nice glow, but i think price is high for the strength. Best for normal to slightly sensitive skin wanting radiance more than heavy pigmentation correction.it doesn't have any color.
Right out of the bottle, it feels silky and hydrating without being sticky. It layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen, which makes it easy to work into both AM and PM routines.

avis.titre: This is a permanent staple in my skincare routine.
avis.texte: I've been using this Vitamin C serum consistently, and the difference in my skin has been incredible. My complexion looks brighter, smoother, and noticeably healthier overall. What really stands out is how much it's improved my skin's longevity—my skin feels stronger, more resilient, and just better over time, not just temporarily. Fine lines look softened, my tone is more even, and I get that fresh, healthy glow even on days I skip makeup. The texture absorbs beautifully without irritation, which is rare for a Vitamin C product. This serum has truly elevated my skincare routine and delivered visible, lasting results. I'll definitely be repurchasing.
Using this for about 2 weeks now and my skin loves it. My skin looks brighter and more dewy. And it's not too harsh like some other vitamin C products I've used.

Been using this Vitamin C serum for few weeks and I'm in love with it! The consistency is great - it's rich and luxurious without being too heavy or oily. A little goes a long way! It absorbs quickly and leaves my skin hydrated and glowing. Notices visible brightness after continuous use. Highly recommend

I tried this Vitamin C serum for 3 weeks. It felt good and maintained my complexion, but I did not see any significant change. I believe there are "as good" vitamin c serums on the market that cost less.

I wanna start off by saying, before I post a review I like to try the product out for a couple of weeks. This serum has worked very well for my skin. Compared to other similar serums, I didn't experience any itchiness, redness or sensitivity. My skin was angry at all actually! By the end of my second week; I've noticed some old pimple spots that appeared darker… have become lighter. My overall skin looked refreshed. A couple drops of this product goes a very long way so be mindful when using. I'll be picking up another bottle, once this one becomes close to empty. I'll be recommending this to several of my sisters! ❤️

I really wanted to give this Pure C Serum a better rating, but it is so oily, that it stained my pillow case. It sits on top of your skin rather than absorbing like other serums do. In the morning, my face was definitely softer, but I saw no real difference in appearance. The scent is wonderful!

avis.titre: Great Vitamin C, but it takes more time for absorption.
avis.texte: I have been applying vitamin C to my face for about 3 weeks. I can tell this is a nice Vitamin C, very gentle on the skin. My wrinkles become less visible and my skin becomes smoother after waking up in the morning thanks to this product. I noticed a slight improvement in my brighter skin, but it may take some time for it to improve. The only thing I don't like about this vitamin C is that it doesn't absorb right away when applied to my skin. I have to wait for it to completely dry before applying my serum. The instructions on the box don't specify how many drops to apply. I applied too much vitamin C at first, which is why it takes so long to fully dry on my skin. Now I just apply 2-3 drops and it's enough for my face to dry quickly. It smells something, but it's not a great scent.

avis.titre: Has really helped my skin's texture and glow
avis.texte: This product really has impressed me. I have been adamant about using good skincare since I was young but as I am approaching 40 this year, my skin has become more dull and the texture seems more rough and my pores were enlarged. I was suprised to find that this product improved my skin's texture, minimized the appearance of my pores and most noticeably, added a "lit from within" glow. I will continue using and purchase this product when I run out.

Love this serum!! I have sun damage on my forehead and after about three weeks I noticed a definite difference in how dark they were, they're not completely gone yet but I think this is going to be what finally wipes them out! I would absolutely recommend this if you have mild/moderate sun damage!

avis.titre: The BEST serum I've ever used!
avis.texte: I have used so many products to address my skin issues; discoloration, redness, texture, wrinkles. Some things work well but leave my skin feeling greasy or dirty. This serum works so well! Over the past two weeks my skin has softened, the dry patches have disappeared, the redness is gone and the fine wrinkles are less noticeable. My skin is moisturizered and refreshed. The texture of the serum FEELs oily but it is quickly absorbed and leaves no residue. A little goes a long way too! I highly recommend you try this for ANY skin problem you may be facing because it has literally solved all of mine. Although I recieved this product in exchange for my honest review, this is actually one I will be buying! Worth every penny to see these results!

avis.titre: Definitely a new staple to my morning routine
avis.texte: I received Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum to try through BzzAgent, and I've been using it consistently in my morning routine. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly, and it layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen without pilling. After about 1–2 weeks, my skin looked brighter and more even overall—especially around areas where I tend to look dull. I also noticed my skin felt smoother and makeup went on a little better. I do have somewhat sensitive skin, so I started every other day at first and worked up to daily use. I had a little mild tingling the first couple uses, but no lasting irritation once I eased into it. Overall, I like the glow and tone improvement and would keep using it.

I used this product 2x a day. Once before bed and once in the morning. A little goes a long way. It goes on smooth and absorbs effortlessly into your skin. It definitely helps lighten dark areas of skin and its not heavy nor greasy. I would definitely recommend this product as well as buy it.

avis.titre: I would purchase  this item again !
avis.texte: I really liked this product, it works really well for mature skin, it softens my fine lines and wrinkles, it adds a little brightness yo my skin, I've only been using for 2 weeks now. But it has made a big difference in my skin, it does take awhile to soak in to where you can continue with uour skincare routine,, but I have alot of time in morning to do my routine, and at night , so yeah I would buy this again, bcuz it's very effective for my mature skin.

As a busy mom with mild rosacea, I'm super cautious with Vitamin C because a lot of serums can be irritating. This one surprised me in a good way. This Rodan + Fields Pure C serum feels much gentler and didn't cause redness or flare-ups for me. I did make sure to apply my moisturizer with an SPF afterwards. After a few weeks my skin looked brighter and more even, especially on tired days when I wasn't getting much sleep. There are no overnight miracles, but I definitely noticed I had a healthier and fresher look. I also like that it's lightweight and a little goes a long way. If you have sensitive skin and want a gentle Vitamin C that actually does something without irritation, this one has been a solid win for me and I definitely recommend you give it a try. I'm so glad I received this free sample to try and is now a part of my daily routine.
i recived this for testing purposes and it has been so nice to incorporate in to my skin care routine. a lttle goes a long way. i have felt like my skin looks brighter

avis.titre: Hello Glow. Goodbye Dull Florida Skin
avis.texte: Living in Florida means sun, humidity, and nonstop heat, so finding skincare that actually holds up is no joke. I've been using the Pure C Serum from Rodan + Fields and it's become one of my go-to products for keeping my skin looking fresh year-round. The texture feels luxe but lightweight, which is perfect for our climate. It absorbs quickly, doesn't feel sticky, and layers beautifully under sunscreen and makeup. I noticed brighter skin almost right away, and after a couple of weeks my face felt smoother and looked firmer, especially around my cheeks. What I love most is how it helps combat that dull, sun-exposed look we can get living in South Florida. My skin looks more radiant, healthier, and has that natural glow even on busy days. If you're dealing with Florida sun and humidity and want a Vitamin C serum that actually delivers, this one is worth adding to your routine. It's been a great way to keep my skin looking refreshed and glowing, beach days and all ☀️✨

The vitamin C has 10% concentration, which I find to be the perfect percentage as I get no irritation. It is oil free, but feels nourishing and hydrating on the skin. My skin looks brighter more even and the lines and wrinkles appear to be softer.

avis.titre: Love this! Tightened and lifted my skin and erased wrinkles!
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of vitamin C serums, but Pure C Serum honestly stands out. From the very first application, my skin felt tighter and smoother, like it was actually doing something instead of just sitting on the surface. Within minutes I had this fresh, firm feeling that made my face look more awake. After using it consistently, I noticed my fine lines looked softer and my skin had a healthy glow that didn't need highlighter to fake it. My complexion looks brighter, more even, and just… happier. It absorbs quickly, isn't greasy, and layers well under moisturizer and makeup. It really feels like a professional-level product at home. If you want brighter, firmer-looking skin with that lit-from-within glow, this serum is absolutely worth it.

avis.titre: This serum really brightened my skin!!
avis.texte: When I first received this serum, I was already blown away by the packaging. Once I started using it, I love how the texture was not watery, and was very easy to apply and absorb into my skin. I've been using it over the past couple of weeks and noticed that it has brightened up my skin tone and reduced some of the visible blemishes on my left cheek.

Having used this for weeks, I'm disappointed. I haven't noticed any brightening nor any improved texture. The texture of this serum is light and does sink in quickly. My skin is normal with no sensitivity issues. This is a one of the more stable vitamin c serum that I've used, which is impressive. It hasn't oxidized in the weeks I've used it. However, it hasn't done much for my skin at all. I cannot recommend this product.

It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any sticky or greasy residue, which makes it easy to use both morning and night. During the day, I layer it under my tinted SPF moisturizer, and it sits really well without pilling or feeling heavy. At night, I use it alongside my anti-acne skincare routine, and it hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. After using it consistently, my skin looks brighter and more even, and I love the healthy glow it gives. My skin can be sensitive, so I appreciate that this vitamin C feels gentle while still being effective.

Saw amazing results with this product! The vitamin C serum goes on like an oil but dries amazingly well and a little bit of serum goes a long . I saw a reduction in my fine lines around my eyes, which was a huge benefit. Definitely will purchase another bottle when this one runs out.

Lightweight and not sticky at all this vitamin C serum absorbs quickly and gives my skin a healthy glow which i need. After a couple weeks, my complexion looks brighter and more even. This has been added to my daily skin care routine
The item was okay. I would not recommend if you don't like an oil based type of product. The product is oily. I am more of a moisture water based product. I would not purchase

avis.titre: This is the best serum I've ever used
avis.texte: I wash my face, use toner, use this serum, face moisturizer, and sunscreen. This has become my favorite serum. It's so creamy and makes my face feel amazing. My face has never felt better after I used it. I feel like I can see an improvement in my skin.

Rodan + Fields Pure C Serum delivers a bright, smooth finish with a potent dose of vitamin C. Lightweight and fast-absorbing, it helps even tone, boosts radiance, and improves texture over time. Skin looks healthier and more luminous with consistent use. Highly recommend!
